section_summary.extract_value: This section presents confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) results for the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) conducted on Study X with N=345 participants. The analysis confirmed a one-dimensional structure with acceptable model fit and demonstrated configural invariance, factor loading invariance, and intercept invariance across sex, supporting the validity of the BAS-2 as a unidimensional measure of body appreciation.
